keepsakes.name: Odile’s window tissue
keepsakes.text: The tissue has four corner pricks. The word under the fold was never on the original sheet.
keepsakes.where: Finish the main case in the Cold Store.
keepsakes.use: Carry it to a colleague in each of two other worlds.

keepsakes.name: Ruan’s sounding tab
keepsakes.text: Two notches preserve the interval between the harbour bell and its echo.
keepsakes.where: Finish the main case in the Observatory Coast.
keepsakes.use: Carry it to a colleague in each of two other worlds.

keepsakes.name: Ayla’s grass sleeve
keepsakes.text: A grass blade leans out of the sleeve each time the watcher turns into the wind.
keepsakes.where: Finish the main case in the Living Forest.
keepsakes.use: Carry it to a colleague in each of two other worlds.

keepsakes.name: Corra’s trial shim
keepsakes.text: The thin brass tongue is marked on one face where the test jaw gripped it.
keepsakes.where: Finish the main case in the Metalworks.
keepsakes.use: Carry it to a colleague in each of two other worlds.

keepsakes.name: Mina’s type space
keepsakes.text: A low piece of type kept the words on either side from running together. It leaves no ink.
keepsakes.where: Finish the main case in the City of Copies.
keepsakes.use: Carry it to a colleague in each of two other worlds.

keepsakes.name: Sora’s knotted sounding loop
keepsakes.text: A dark line in the rope shows how far the slack end once sagged.
keepsakes.where: Finish the main case in the Cartographers’ Sea.
keepsakes.use: Carry it to a colleague in each of two other worlds.

keepsakeTalks.text: Stretch the tissue across the signal window.
Lay the tissue over the lender’s copy.
Tap the second notch beside the recorder.
Hang the tab where the mist bell carries.
Stand the sleeve beside the sample pans.
Stand the sleeve at the case hinge.
Slip the shim under the low corner of the type.
Seat the shim against the loose gauge.
Try the type space between the two shore names.
Set the type space at the silent interval on the strip.
Loop the cord across the bowed shelf.
Stretch the loop between the two delivery hooks.

dialogue.speaker: coast-signalkeeper
dialogue.text: That pale shape comes from the patch on my glass. Look, it moves when you move the tissue. I sign for the lamps here. If a fisher reports two lights tonight, send them to me.

dialogue.speaker: copies-lendingkeeper
dialogue.text: There is room for the name under this fold. I was about to write it back from memory. Hold the paper still. I will trace the blank so the next borrower can see exactly where it falls.

dialogue.speaker: forest-naturalist
dialogue.text: There it is again. I counted the reply in the gully as a second bird. Please stay while I cross out my own initials. I would sooner you saw me do it.

dialogue.speaker: sea-harbourkeeper
dialogue.text: I can hear the echo after my boat has passed the post. A skipper approaching from the other direction hears it sooner. Give me the wet chalk. I need a second ear marked on this chart.

dialogue.speaker: metal-inspector
dialogue.text: It is the open door. Every time the porter leaves, the light pan lifts. I made my apprentice weigh it twelve times. Will you help me tell her why?

dialogue.speaker: preserved-royal-keeper
dialogue.text: Drawers breathing! I told my little girl the papers could breathe, and here we are. Watch this corner curl when the door opens. That crease alone cannot tell us who unfolded the file.

dialogue.speaker: copies-presskeeper
dialogue.text: The missing letter prints again! I had thought our apprentice forgot to set it. Here, take the first clean sheet. I owe the second one to him.

dialogue.speaker: coast-forecaster
dialogue.text: Keep your thumb there. The zero slides when the housing moves. Yesterday I read the number correctly and gave the harbour a bad reading anyway.

dialogue.speaker: sea-cartographer
dialogue.text: From this low ferry seat the names run together. Now I can point to either landing with my little finger. My pilot taught me those as separate places; I printed them as one.

dialogue.speaker: forest-steward
dialogue.text: The gap is exactly where I turned the spool. People saw the blank and came to tell me the birds had gone. I can label my pause myself. You hold the end.

dialogue.speaker: preserved-registrar
dialogue.text: Two labels slid downhill to the same case. My tidy list made it look like two witnesses agreed. Help me lift the shelf. I want to see what is underneath.

dialogue.speaker: metal-steward
dialogue.text: The full coil sags past the lower hook. I used to charge the carriers for that difference. At closing I will walk the hooks with them and measure under load.
